title: Search box on the notes list

source.title: Add a search box to the notes list
source.author: casey

leftOut.text: Sorting the notes by date is a separate change
Whether the box should also search note bodies

checks.title: Notes list loads
checks.why: The list is what the search box filters, so it has to draw first.

where.text: The Notes page of the preview

do.see: A list of four notes is drawn

checks.passes: Four rows: Milk run, Plan the week, Call the vet, Water the plants.
checks.fails: An empty list, or a spinner that never ends.
checks.nothingFromHere: The preview is only reachable from your browser.
checks.evidence: Opened the preview earlier: four notes drawn

checks.title: Open the Notes page
checks.why: Start from the page the search box lives on.

where.text: The local preview of the app

do.see: The terminal prints the local address

do.text: Open the Notes page in the browser
do.see: The notes list is drawn with a search box on top

checks.passes: The page shows four notes and an empty search box.
checks.fails: The page is blank, or the search box is missing.
checks.nothingFromHere: Only you can see the page in your browser.

checks.title: Type a word in the search box
checks.why: Typing is how the filter is used, so it is the first thing to try.
checks.undo: Clear the search box so the list is full again.

where.text: The Notes page, top of the list

do.text: Click the box, type `milk` and look for note `note-4821`
do.see: Only the row Milk run is left

do.text: Switch to the branch `feature/notes-search` and reload

checks.fails: More than one row stays, or the box rejects the letters.
checks.nothingFromHere: The typing happens in your browser.

checks.title: The filter keeps the list order
checks.why: A filtered list must keep the order of the full list.
checks.precheck: Already proved: the list helper filters without sorting.

do.see: Plan the week, Call the vet and Water the plants stay, in that order

checks.passes: The three rows keep their original order.
checks.fails: Any row moves above one that was above it before.

images.alt: The notes list filtered by the letter a
images.caption: Expected list after typing a

checks.title: An empty result says so
checks.why: A blank list looks like a bug; the page should say nothing matched.

do.see: The list is replaced by one line of text

checks.passes: The page shows `No notes match` and no rows.
checks.fails: A blank area, or the old rows stay.

checks.title: Search word stays in the address
checks.why: A shared link should reopen the same filter.

where.text: The address bar of the preview

do.see: The address ends with the search word

checks.nothingFromHere: The address bar is in your browser.
checks.evidence: Works in the preview of the open PR, not on the live site yet

checks.title: Escape clears the box
checks.why: Escape is the quick way back to the full list, and the next check counts rows.

do.see: The box empties and all four rows return

checks.passes: The box is empty and four rows are drawn.
checks.blocksWhy: The count line reads the cleared box

checks.title: The count line follows the filter
checks.why: The count line tells you how many notes are left after filtering.

do.text: Type `milk` and read the line under the box

checks.nothingFromHere: The line is drawn in your browser.

checks.title: Search ignores letter case

do.see: The row Milk run is still found

checks.passes: The row `Milk run` is shown for `MILK`.
checks.fails: The list is empty for capital letters.

checks.title: Box stays visible on a narrow window
checks.why: Phones are narrow and the box must not fall off the page.

where.text: The Notes page at 360 pixels wide

do.see: The search box is still in view

checks.passes: The box is fully inside the window.
checks.fails: The box is cut off or needs sideways scroll.
checks.nothingFromHere: Only a real window shows the layout.

checks.title: Reload keeps no stale rows
checks.why: After a reload the list should match the box, which is empty again.
checks.fails: Only one row after the reload.
checks.nothingFromHere: The reload happens in your browser.
